item.title: S'pore man jailed after scamming 12,600 people of over S$106K through fake donation scam
item.description: A man was jailed for 46 months for swindling over 12,600 people of more than S$106,000 through a fake donation scam.

item.title: 'I keep blaming myself': Philippines rescuer loses family to Typhoon Kalmaegi while helping others to safety
item.description: A rescuer lost eight members of his family in a flash flood in Canlaon City, Negros Oriental, Philippines, due to Typhoon Kalmaegi.

item.title: Rider allegedly flees after crashing into car at JB, motorcycle has both S'pore and M'sia licence plates
item.description: A rider violently crashed into a car in JB and fled the scene, with his motorcycle illegally having Singapore and Malaysia licence plates.

item.title: Drunk S'pore man locks pregnant wife in home, sentenced to over 4 months' jail after police free her
item.description: A drunk man in Singapore yanked his pregnant wife by the hair & locked her in their home, resulting in police freeing her & arresting him.

item.title: Man filmed allegedly selling durians illegally from M'sia-registered car boot in Punggol
item.description: A Malaysia‑registered car was caught on camera allegedly selling durians to passersby from its car boot in Punggol.

item.title: 65-year-old man found dead at foot of Redhill HDB block, no foul play suspected
item.description: A 65-year-old man was found dead at the foot of an HDB block at Block 71 Redhill Road. Police do not suspect foul play.

item.title: M'sian company's 'Intern of the Month' post goes viral for resembling obituary, intern says he's 'still here'
item.description: A Malaysian company has unintentionally gone viral after its “Intern of the Month” announcement bore an uncanny resemblance to an obituary.

item.title: Amos Yee detained by ICE in the US, may be deported to S'pore
item.description: Amos Yee has been detained by the United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and may be deported to Singapore.

item.title: S’pore civil servants to get 1.3-month year-end bonus, junior officers will receive S$600 more
item.description: All Singapore civil servants will get a 1.3-month year-end bonus this year, with junior officers receiving a one-payment of S$600.

item.title: 15 CASE complaints over closure of Wan Yang foot reflexology chain, over S$29K of losses reported
item.description: CASE has received 15 complaints so far over the sudden closure of Wan Yang foot reflexology chain, with over S$29,000 in losses reported.
